verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can upload fine-tuned models from your own S3 bucket, track versions, and deploy them alongside standard models. This works only on a dedicated endpoint, a private provisioned instance reserved for your organization, not on the self-serve public API. missing for 10: custom-weight serving on the shared/self-serve tier, any evidence of LoRA adapter support, details on supported architectures/formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.
